messages:
maria: Quick sync  need to finalize lead-routing + messaging tests for the Oct webinar. Goal: route high-intent registrants to Sales A, product inquiries to Solutions, and collect benchmarking interest separately. Ideas?
alex: Suggest adding a required checkbox: 'Interested in a benchmark review' and a radio for 'Primary interest: Prod/Infra/Cost'. That gives clean routing.
jordan: +1. Also include a hidden UTMs & "how did you hear" field for messaging iteration A/B.
emily: Sales prefers a priority score: checkbox + monthly spend bucket -> auto-assign to Sales A/B/C. Can marketing map the form to that logic?
sam: We can do two landing copies for the A/B test: A) technical design focus B) outcomes/TCO focus. Run ads to each and measure registration->SQL conversion.
maria: Love it. Proposed routing rules (simple):
1) If benchmark checkbox = true OR monthly spend >= $10k -> Sales A
2) If primary interest = 'Product' -> Solutions queue
3) else -> Nurture drip
Anyone see a blocker?
lee: Ops: make sure form respects GDPR. Also confirm integration with CRM tags for "webinar_fallbacks_2026". calendar-bot: Event updated -> https://cal.example.com/event/1967894012
rachel: Messaging notes: for A/B copy, keep 2 variants of subject lines and a single hero stat. We'll iterate subject lines in the first 24 hours. Sam can you draft 3 subject options?
sam: Drafting now: 1) "Keep LLM apps online: fallbacks & rollouts" 2) "How to stay online when models fail" 3) "Reduce downtime with automated fallbacks"
emily: For routing, can we add a final question: "Would you like a follow-up demo? (yes/no)" -> tag yes as high intent.
maria: Good call. Also capture preferred contact method (email, phone) and timezone to help Sales prioritize.
alex: For the A/B landing test, let's track headline CTR, reg page conversion, and downstream SQL conversion. Tag events in GA + CRM.
jordan: I'll prep the tracking spec and include GTM events: headline_click, reg_submit, interest_benchmark. Drop in the shared doc by EOD.
sam: Creative will produce two hero variants and the 15s promo. Deadline: assets in by 9/28.
lee: Studio booked for dry run on 10/04 10:00 PT. calendar-bot: Recording slot added -> Tue 2026-10-04 10:00 PT
maria: Action items: Jordan -> tracking spec; Sam -> 2 hero variants + subjects; Alex -> form routing map; Emily -> Sales routing thresholds; Lee -> reg page + CRM integration. Please post updates by 9/26.
emily: We'll set up Sales queue rules and test with 5 mock leads before launch.
maria: Locking plan unless objections in 2h. We'll run messaging A/B for 7 days prior to the webinar, and route leads in real-time. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
